facts.fact: The Ministry of Finance plan says Mogadishu Customs introduced electronic customs systems, SOMCAS implemented in February 2022 alongside the current Port Customs Management Information System (PCMIS).

Shabelle Media reports Somalia's finance minister and the UK ambassador reviewed progress in implementing digital customs systems at Mogadishu Port, centred on the UK-supported SOMCAS online platform.
